pages.title: Koch Crystal
pages.text: A pane whose rim is a Koch snowflake: a finite area enclosed by an infinitely long border. The glass is clear, but its edge glitters endlessly as each tiny triangle catches light. Set it against a lamp and the outline seems to keep growing as I stare.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)First turned up in a chest deep inside a Hilbert archive, wrapped like a specimen. Measuring its perimeter with finer and finer rulers, the number never settled. A border with no length is still a border.
Made in $(item)Analytic Continuator$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Hilbert Archive chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Platonic Realm.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Christoffel Symbol, Fractal Set.
